create_EmbeddingPoolerHead: create an EmbeddingPoolerHead with optional projector, head_dtype, and activation for embedding generation
create_ClassifierPoolerHead: create a ClassifierPoolerHead with optional classifier, logit_mean, logit_sigma, head_dtype, and activation for classification
build_SquencePoolerHead: build a SequencePoolerHead abstract base class defining get_supported_tasks and forward interface
